findings.clean_membership_boundary: The mapped F0 split totals 10,535 fit-train, 1,405 fit-valid, and 468 evaluation-valid groups. The text correctly defines train+valid as the first two sets, valid-only as fit.valid, and requires all 468 evaluation groups to remain outside every fitted learned ancestor, cache/preprocessing fit, student and selection. Canonical membership selection and campaign split assertions support those intended groups; this is a future contract, not evidence of historical membership.
findings.precision_and_propensity: The strict-FP32 requirement is stated as a comparison-wide constraint. The canonical training README says FP16 remains the legacy CLI default and strict-FP32 recipes must pass --precision fp32. The pinned propensity trainer specifically wraps its fit forward in CUDA float16 autocast and computes mean/std from the first batch of its shuffled loader, so the stated propensity gap is supported. The cache-propensity sidecar records model hash/split/counts but not canonical split-manifest SHA or ordered group identity. The packet does not claim that all canonical training already meets the strict-FP32 requirement.
findings.tied_lead: The pinned model CLI/factory exposes ordinary architectures and feature encoders but no tied-lead architecture selector; input assembly concatenates declared feature blocks and does not guarantee the archived shared encoder over 52 lead channels. The map appropriately requires a reviewed adapter or an explicitly different architecture, and does not call an arbitrary 263-wide input equivalent to the archived member.
findings.teacher_scale: Pinned canonical combination code confirms main_source as the unnormalized coefficient sum, main_normalized as division by the coefficient total, main_homogeneous as the total times one selected family mean, and family outputs as per-family means. The packet keeps these variants distinct and explicitly states that the historical source/cache aliases are not bound to those producing arrays, row order, or orgbase placement.
findings.historical_limits_and_scope: Saved W18/fin256 metadata are presented as configuration leads, not run-bound proof of source, optimizer execution/state, clean membership, or cache production. The text preserves the fixed 0.34/0.33/0.33 mixture and CP30 design, distinguishes this modified counterpart from an exact public-TL3 replica and from the frozen rank-1 campaign, and records unresolved ancestors and target choices.
findings.readiness: README and manifest consistently label this as a metadata-only readiness map, not a recipe, preregistration, command, fit authorization, or admission. No executable-looking placeholder command is provided. The minimum gates are actionable without implying that the experiment is ready to run.

limitations: This review validates the bounded readiness-map claims against its pinned local evidence and canonical source files; it does not establish that historical production artifacts executed those semantics or had clean F0 membership.
The local archive hash is not tied to portal-uploaded bytes, and cache aliases are not bound to their producing command/source or ordered rows.
No checkpoint/array payloads were read, and no training, inference, tests, remote action, or external operation was performed.
No modified recipe is preregistered or authorized by this review.
